previous_autonomous_wave.result: Unified continuous and discrete product token-producing routes under one serialized AW17 authority while preserving pre-token continuous coalescing; portable barrier stress/benchmark passed; PARITY not promoted.

latest_autonomous_wave.goal: Add an interruption lifecycle state gate around AW17 so product controls cannot resume or consume generations while an OS interruption is active, and automatic resume follows explicit user intent plus the OS shouldResume signal under actor reentrancy.
latest_autonomous_wave.rationale: AW17 serialized interruption tokens but treated interruption begin/end as isolated transport events. Product semantics still needed a durable active-interruption state, explicit resume policy, ordering against already-started play-state commands, nested-interruption stale-completion protection and a fail-closed end-recovery state.
latest_autonomous_wave.done_when: Ordinary controls are rejected pre-token while interrupted; pause can suppress resume without a token; begin waits for older play-state intents before arming resume; end resumes only when both OS shouldResume and armed intent allow it; pause/new interruption races cannot publish stale resumed state; failed end authority requires explicit recovery; deterministic race tests, 50000-cycle stress, benchmark and durable evidence pass; Apple/device/audibility/PARITY claims remain disabled.
